title: The Signal - Library of Congress Digital Preservation Blog
description: The Signal is the Library of Congress blog on digital preservation, digital collections, and technology. It covers topics including APIs, digitization, web archiving, and access to digital cultural heritage.
feed_nature_note: Whether these posts are the vendor publishing or its support community, decided on the URL path grammar of the saved posts -- not the hostname, which carries both on Khoros, and not author diversity, which flags large vendor blogs as forums. 'undetermined' means undetermined.
